bagPolicy.summary: One clear plastic or vinyl tote up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, or a nonclear clutch up to 6 × 9 inches, is permitted; all bags are searched.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There is no onsite parking. The venue suggests the Seaport Hotel Garage, entered from Seaport Boulevard at B Street, and other nearby paid garages.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visit and transportation guide does not designate a rideshare pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold inside; selections and prices vary by event. The venue is cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue publishes a separate accessibility guide; request an interpreter at least two weeks in advance after purchasing a ticket. The pavilion does not control guest parking.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The pavilion visit guide does not publish a general re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets can be collected once doors open with photo ID and the purchasing credit card; artist guest-list tickets are also generally released at door time.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates usually open 60–90 minutes before showtime; exact times vary. Guests pass metal detectors and bag checks, and the show-day box office opens at 1 p.m.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
